name: Alejandro Domenez
abstract: Alejandro Agustín Domenez is an Argentine football midfielder currently playing for Gimnasia y Esgrima. Domenez made his league debut in a 3–1 defeat by Arsenal de Sarandí on 5 August 2006. In 2007, he was loaned to Almagro of the Argentine 2nd division. Since his return to Gimnasia in 2008 he has failed to return to first team football. (in Spanish) Argentine Primera statistics
